functions.name: run_tribunal
functions.title: Run Truth Tribunal
functions.description: Run Aether's 3-way proposer/critic/verifier tribunal on a question to produce a warranted, hallucination-checked answer. Use when the user needs a trustworthy, independently-verified answer to a factual question. Returns the hardened answer, a calibrated trust score (0-100), a cryptographically signed warrant, and certification status. Creates an Inquiry, AnswerVersion, and Warrant record owned by the signed-in user.

prompt.description: The question to answer and verify.

stakes.description: Decision stakes. low=fast single-model answer; medium=2-model tribunal; high/critical=full 3-way tribunal with cross-firm verification. Defaults to medium.

model.description: Optional model id for the low-stakes single-model path only (e.g. automatic, gemini_3_flash, claude_sonnet_4_6). Ignored for medium and above.

functions.name: verify_answer
functions.title: Verify an AI Answer
functions.description: Independently attest an AI-generated answer for hallucinations. Decomposes the text into atomic claims, grounds them against the web, runs the tribunal, signs a cryptographic warrant, and returns a calibrated trust score (0-100), verdict (verified/contested/rejected), warrant id, and red-team certification. Use when the user already has AI-generated text and wants it checked, rather than asking a fresh question.

answer_text.description: The AI-generated answer text to verify.

stakes.description: Decision stakes — drives warrant expiry and verification depth. Defaults to medium.

premises.description: Explicit premises the answer depends on, if known.

sources.description: Supporting or contradicting source URLs (http/https only) to ground the verification.

model_label.description: Optional label for the model that produced the answer (for metering/audit).

functions.name: check_gate
functions.title: Check Release Gate
functions.description: Run the callable suppression gate on a previously-verified answer (by its answer_version_id / lineage_id). Returns an allow / escalate / suppress decision plus the trust score, warrant status, certification, and reason — so low-trust or fabricated answers can be blocked before reaching end users. Read-only: it does not modify the answer.

answer_version_id.description: The AnswerVersion id (also accepted as lineage_id) returned by a prior verify_answer or run_tribunal call.

functions.name: lookup_warrant
functions.title: Look Up Signed Warrant
functions.description: Retrieve a cryptographically signed warrant by its id (or by verification_id / lineage_id), or list the append-only warrant transparency chain. Use to verify the signature, trust score, premises, cited sources, and expiry of a previously-issued verification. Pass a warrant_id or verification_id to fetch one warrant; omit all ids to list recent warrants.

verification_id.description: Alternative lookup key: the answer_version_id / lineage_id returned by a prior verification.

limit.description: Max chain entries to return when no id is given. 1-500, defaults to 100.

functions.name: search_claims
functions.title: Search Verified Claims
functions.description: Search Aether's public claim-verification registry: individual factual claims extracted from verified GitHub pull requests, each with an adjudicated verdict, risk level, policy decision, and a summary of the evidence behind it. Use to check whether a specific claim has already been adjudicated, to survey how claims in a category or risk band were decided, or to cite prior verification history. Returns public PR-verification claims only — private tribunal claims are not searchable and no tenant or author identifiers are returned. Read-only.

text_query.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the claim text.

limit.description: Max claims to return. 1-100, defaults to 20.
